concepts.gloss_en: The mochin (mind/intellect) of the Land of Israel — the supernal intellect associated with Eretz Yisrael, in the aspect of no'am

members.note: plene/defective spelling variant of מוחין (mem-vav-chet vs mem-chet); same word, same usage in lm2:71

concepts.gloss_en: The charity of the Land of Israel — tzedakah as the vessel to receive the supernal no'am; distinct concept (charity, not intellect)

members.note: different construct head (tzedakah, not mochin); a distinct concept despite token overlap on 'of the Land of Israel'

notes: Mechanical token-overlap wrongly grouped these; only the two mochin spellings are the same concept. צדקה is a separate head (Rule 4).
